entries.key: Adds a launch bar that swings down to connect to an aircraft carrier catapult.
entries.value: 增加一根可向下摆出、用于连接航母弹射器的弹射杆。

entries.key: Adds a second set of blades spinning the opposite way.
entries.value: 增加一组反向旋转的桨叶。

entries.key: Adjusts the maximum output RPM. Power stays constant, so lower RPM means more torque.
entries.value: 调整最大输出转速。功率不变，因此转速越低扭矩越大。

entries.key: Blade pitch can be fixed, hold a constant RPM automatically, or follow an input controller.
entries.value: 桨距可以固定、自动保持恒定转速，或跟随输入控制器。

entries.key: Changes how many are duplicated around the missile.
entries.value: 改变导弹周围复制出的数量。

entries.key: Changes the length of the nozzle. Does not affect performance.
entries.value: 改变尾喷口长度，不影响性能。

entries.key: Changes the length of the shroud.
entries.value: 改变整流罩长度。

entries.key: Controls the order in which decals are rendered when they are overlapping
entries.value: 控制贴花重叠时的渲染顺序

entries.key: Determines which parts are affected.
entries.value: 决定受影响的零件。

entries.key: Engine vents whatever the selected engine is burning. Input drives the plume from any input or expression.
entries.value: 排气管排放所选发动机正在燃烧的产物。输入可用任意输入或表达式驱动尾焰。

entries.key: Flips the assembly's layout. The exact behavior depends on the selected wheel-assembly style.
entries.value: 翻转轮组布局。具体效果取决于所选的轮组形式。

entries.key: Flips the gear leg to the other side.
entries.value: 把起落架支柱翻到另一侧。

entries.key: How big each particle is.
entries.value: 每个粒子的大小。

entries.key: How far past flat the blades turn at full reverse input. Zero disables reverse thrust.
entries.value: 反推输入拉满时桨叶越过零距的角度。设为 0 则禁用反推。

entries.key: How hard the gas shoots out of the pipe.
entries.value: 气体喷出管口的力度。

entries.key: How long particles last before fading.
entries.value: 粒子从出现到消失的持续时间。

entries.key: How many particles the plume emits. Turn it up for thick smoke, down for a thin haze.
entries.value: 尾焰喷出的粒子数量。调高是浓烟，调低是薄雾。

entries.key: How much the plume billows out as it trails away.
entries.value: 尾焰拖远时扩散的程度。

entries.key: How quickly the air slows the plume down.
entries.value: 空气让尾焰减速的快慢。

entries.key: How strongly the effect shows.
entries.value: 效果的明显程度。

entries.key: How wide the plume opens up.
entries.value: 尾焰张开的宽度。

entries.key: It greatly increases the power of the engine but it decreases efficiency.
entries.value: 大幅提升发动机功率，但会降低效率。

entries.key: Links this animator under another so they share one timeline.
entries.value: 把这个动画器挂到另一个之下，使它们共用一条时间轴。

entries.key: More blades give more thrust at the same RPM, but more drag and mass to spin.
entries.value: 相同转速下桨叶越多推力越大，但阻力与转动惯量也更大。

entries.key: More stages improve fuel efficiency and power, but add length and mass.
entries.value: 级数越多，燃油效率与功率越高，但长度与质量也会增加。

entries.key: Positive floats the plume upwards like hot smoke, negative lets it fall.
entries.value: 正值让尾焰像热烟一样上浮，负值则下沉。

entries.key: Pushes the plume out of the pipe or pulls it back in.
entries.value: 把尾焰推出管外或吸回管内。

entries.key: Reduces the turning angle as speed increases.
entries.value: 速度越快，转向角度越小。

entries.key: Reverses the direction of the spin.
entries.value: 反转旋转方向。

entries.key: Reverses the spin direction and flips the blades to match.
entries.value: 反转旋转方向并相应翻转桨叶。

entries.key: Running hotter produces more power from the same engine, at the cost of heavier alloys and cooling.
entries.value: 温度越高，同一台发动机功率越大，但需要更重的合金与冷却系统。

entries.key: Select the engine inside of this shroud.
entries.value: 选择这个整流罩内部的发动机。

entries.key: Selects which support strut is mounted here, or None.
entries.value: 选择此处安装哪根支撑支柱，或选“无”。

entries.key: Selects which torque link is mounted, or None.
entries.value: 选择安装哪种扭矩连杆，或选“无”。

entries.key: Stretches the shroud horizontally.
entries.value: 水平拉伸整流罩。

entries.key: Stretches the shroud vertically.
entries.value: 垂直拉伸整流罩。

entries.key: The blade angle in Fixed mode, or the governor's coarse pitch limit in Auto mode.
entries.value: 固定模式下的桨叶角度，或自动模式下调速器的最大桨距限制。

entries.key: The color of the base of the afterburner, for fun.
entries.value: 加力燃烧室根部的颜色，纯属好玩。

entries.key: The color of the tip of the afterburner, also for fun.
entries.value: 加力燃烧室尖端的颜色，也是纯属好玩。

entries.key: The engine whose exhaust this pipe vents. Set automatically when attached to an engine, and kept if moved.
entries.value: 这根排气管所排放的发动机。连接到发动机时会自动设置，移动后仍会保留。

entries.key: The engine's rated power at sea level. Power falls off with altitude as the air thins.
entries.value: 发动机在海平面的额定功率。随高度上升、空气稀薄，功率会下降。

entries.key: The maximum range the nozzle can gimbal.
entries.value: 尾喷口可偏转的最大角度。

entries.key: The other colour particles are picked between. Pull the two apart to give smoke more variation.
entries.value: 粒子颜色在两者之间取值。两种颜色差别越大，烟雾的变化越丰富。

entries.key: The overall compression of the intake air and the resulting fuel efficiency.
entries.value: 进气总压缩比及其带来的燃油效率。

entries.key: The overall size of the pipe.
entries.value: 排气管的整体尺寸。

entries.key: The particles this pipe emits.
entries.value: 这根排气管喷出的粒子。

entries.key: The position of the shock. Purely cosmetic.
entries.value: 激波的位置，纯属外观。

entries.key: The rate at which the nozzle gimbals
entries.value: 尾喷口的偏转速率

entries.key: The selected nozzle does not support afterburner.
entries.value: 所选的尾喷口不支持加力燃烧。

entries.key: The style of the pipe.
entries.value: 排气管的样式。

entries.key: The torque delivered at governed RPM. A free turbine delivers up to double this from a standstill.
entries.value: 调速转速下输出的扭矩。自由涡轮在静止时可输出最多两倍于此的扭矩。

entries.key: This is the throttle at which the afterburner will kick in.
entries.value: 加力燃烧开始介入的油门位置。

entries.key: Tints the particles. White is default, and the alpha thins the plume out.
entries.value: 给粒子着色。默认白色，透明度越低尾焰越淡。

entries.key: Turns the blades edge-on to the airflow when the engine stops.
entries.value: 发动机停车时让桨叶转至与气流平行。
